input.summary: Extend software warranty to 12 months from acceptance (removing the Dec 31, 1999 sunset) and add a services warranty with a re-performance/refund remedy.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the product warranty to twelve (12) months running from acceptance rather than sixty (60) days from the Effective Date with a December 31, 1999 sunset, and added a professional and workmanlike warranty with a re-performance or refund remedy for the installation, implementation, support and professional services, since the agreement currently warrants only the Software. Our playbook position is 12 months for software and 90 days for services with repair, replace or refund; we can fall back to 90 days for the Software warranty if needed.

ops.oldText: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from Corio's acceptance of the Software (the "Warranty Period")

ops.text: 7.5 Services Warranty. Commerce One warrants that all installation, implementation, support, training and other professional services provided under this Agreement will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards, and that each deliverable will conform in all material respects to its documentation for ninety (90) days following delivery. Corio's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Commerce One's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services or deliverable.
